description: Source code for the AudioStreamLegacy class, implementing audio stream handling, callbacks, and device management in the Android AAudio framework.

classes.name: AudioStreamLegacy
classes.description: Class implementing legacy audio stream handling, including data callbacks, device updates, and timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: callDataCallbackFrames
methods.description: Invokes the data callback with the provided buffer and frame count, handling input/output direction logic.

methods.name: onProcessFixedBlock
methods.description: Processes a fixed block of audio data, converting byte size to frame count and calling the data callback.

methods.name: onNewIAudioTrack
methods.description: Handles the event of a new audio track connection, logging and disconnecting the stream.

methods.name: onMoreData
methods.description: Provides more data to the audio track or record buffer, managing callback results and disconnections.

methods.name: checkForDisconnectRequest
methods.description: Checks if a disconnect has been requested and handles it accordingly.

methods.name: forceDisconnect
methods.description: Forces disconnection of the stream, optionally triggering error callbacks.

methods.name: getBestTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the best timestamp for the stream based on specified clock, updating frame position.

methods.name: onAudioDeviceUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the audio device, managing disconnection requests based on device changes.
